trust_decision.summary: multi_done() decides when connection filters must drop all per-transfer state for `data` (CF_CTRL_DATA_DONE); at the pinned commit it sends that event before Curl_req_done() flushes the request's remaining upload/EOS, so the final send re-creates per-transfer filter state (an HTTP/2 stream ctx) after the filter was told the transfer is finished.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'HTTP/2 upload Use-After-Free', so an engineer goes to the HTTP/2 filter's stream teardown (http2_data_done) and the send path that creates streams (cf_h2_send/h2_submit). The published fix is in the generic transfer-lifecycle code in lib/multi.c instead.

fix_sites.entry_point: curl_multi_perform / curl_multi_socket_action / curl_easy_perform (transfer completion via multi_runsingle -> multi_done) and curl_multi_remove_handle (lib/multi.c:794)
fix_sites.module_kind: core transfer lifecycle (multi state machine), protocol-agnostic

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix is one hunk in one function (fix.diff:9-38). The same 'DATA_DONE then send creates the stream again' shape also exists in the HTTP/3 filters (lib/vquic/cf-quiche.c:312-323 with lib/vquic/cf-quiche.c:1124-1125; lib/vquic/cf-ngtcp2.c:942-943 with lib/vquic/cf-ngtcp2.c:796). The multi.c reordering covers them implicitly, but the fix diff does not touch them.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names HTTP/2, so a solver who patches http2.c (for example, refusing to re-create a stream after done) can argue that the QUIC/HTTP/3 filters are a different protocol, built only optionally, and out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A normal (non-premature) upload must still get its final flush: buffered request body and the 0-length EOS send in req_flush must reach the connection before it goes back to the pool. A fix that drops the flush, or that makes cf_h2_send refuse every send for a transfer with no stream ctx, would break uploads and first-request submission (h2_submit creates the stream lazily on first send).

O6_input_shapes: non-premature completion with send buffer still non-empty (lib/request.c:305-313)
non-premature completion with EOS read but not yet sent, giving a 0-length eos send (lib/request.c:320-327)
conn == NULL: DATA_DONE now only inside the conn branch, and multi_schedule_pending guarded by data->multi (fix.diff:26-37)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second lifecycle path (for example a send or flush issued from Curl_cpool_return / multi_done_locked) that reaches the HTTP/3 filter after DATA_DONE and re-opens a stream for `data`.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The quiche and ngtcp2 send paths open a stream lazily whenever no stream ctx exists, the same design as http2.c:2229-2230. Any new post-DATA_DONE send would plausibly be added by a maintainer adjusting connection-reuse logic.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Detach of a connection from a transfer without first sending CF_CTRL_DATA_DONE, leaving per-transfer filter state behind.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Several sites detach without the filter event (lib/curl_share.c:426, lib/easy.c:795, lib/url.c:216, lib/multi.c:2388). A planted variant that skips Curl_conn_ev_data_done while keeping the connection alive for reuse would look like an ordinary cleanup shortcut.

O9_family: memory safety: use-after-free from lifecycle/cleanup ordering (per-transfer state re-created in a connection filter after its done event)

O10_build.toolchain: autotools or CMake with gcc/clang; needs nghttp2 (and a TLS backend for h2 over TLS, or h2c)
services: local HTTP/2 test server: nghttpx/httpd from tests/http (pytest), or the curl test-suite servers
O10_build.project_tests: tests/http/test_07_upload.py (pytest HTTP/2 upload tests against a local server); tests/data runtests.pl HTTP/2 cases; no test added by the fix

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Patch lib/http2.c so cf_h2_send/http2_data_setup will not re-create a stream ctx after DATA_DONE (or drop the flush). This fixes only HTTP/2, leaves the HTTP/3 filters with the same ordering, and can break legitimate first-send stream creation.

out_of_scope_notes: cf_h2_get_stream_xfer validates mid+xfer_id before resolving data (lib/http2.c:298-306); the exact dangling-pointer path behind the UAF was not traced.
unverified: Exact freed object and dereference site of the UAF: the re-created h2 stream ctx after http2_data_done is shown, but the later dereference was not traced in the time.

Whether the detach-without-DATA_DONE sites (lib/curl_share.c:426, lib/easy.c:795, lib/url.c:216, lib/multi.c:2388) can leave live per-transfer filter state on a reusable connection; not established, so they are not listed in O8.
Whether the HTTP/3 filters (cf-quiche, cf-ngtcp2) were actually exploitable through the same ordering; covered by the generic fix but not confirmed.
O1 counts transfer completion (curl_multi_perform family) and curl_multi_remove_handle as two entry points; curl_easy_cleanup reaches the latter via lib/url.c:211.
